QuestInfo.name: Sun Shower
QuestInfo.0: There is a fox who knows about Maple World. You should ask #bSilver#k to tell you more about them.
QuestInfo.1: It begins raining while you are talking to Silver. Apparently it only rains here when a fox is crying... You should go find Moonbeam.
QuestInfo.2: Worried that the rain in the village is because Moonbeam is crying somewhere, you go looking for her--fearing the worst. Did she give you too much of her power? Thankfully, Moonbeam was safe. She realized you intended to leave the village, and prayed to the Fox God as she cried...
